newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - International Tech Q1 shr loss up.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - International Tech Q1 shr loss up.

text.p: NOTE - (a) Includes $4,611 of special charges related to (1) $2,811 of relocation costs associated with the relocation of the company's corporate headquarters from Torrance, Calif., to Pittsburgh, Pa., and (2) $1,800 from the sale of a small, California-based, project remediation services business.
(b) The provision for income taxes excludes any tax benefits related to the special charges.
(c) Preferred stock dividend includes an imputed non-cash dividend of $634 related to the Carlyle preferred stock.

(d) Net income (loss) per common share is computed by dividing net income (loss) applicable to common stock by the weighted average number of common and common equivalent shares outstanding. For all periods above, net income (loss) per common share is computed based on the assumption that all of the Company's convertible exchangeable preferred stock is converted into common shares, is antidilutive and therefore, is not presented.
Full company name is International Technology Corp
